defaults.description: Global runtime and storage settings for Munin master.

defaults.html_dir.description: Directory where Munin generates HTML output (graphs, indexes).

defaults.lib_dir.description: Directory where RRD files (raw data) are stored.

defaults.log_dir.description: Directory where Munin logs (e.g., munin-update.log) are stored.

defaults.run_dir.description: Directory where runtime files (e.g., PID files) are stored.

defaults.user.description: Unix user account under which Munin processes run.

defaults.group.description: Unix group under which Munin processes run.

defaults.interval.description: Update interval in minutes for graph generation (minimum recommended: 5).

defaults.html_strategy.description: HTML generation strategy: 'static' (preferred for performance) or 'cgi' (for dynamic refresh).

defaults.rrd_strategy.description: RRD update strategy — determines archival and resolution tradeoffs.

contact_groups.description: Contact group definitions for alerting (e.g., email or webhook).

contact_groups.alerts.command.description: Shell command used to send alerts (e.g., email, curl for webhook).

contact_groups.alerts.contacts.description: List of named contacts for alert delivery.

address.description: IP address or hostname of the Munin node (client).

port.description: TCP port used by the Munin node (default 4949).

group.description: Logical group to categorize the node (affects HTML grouping).

use_node_name.description: Whether to use node name as title in graphs ('yes' recommended).

labels.description: Optional key-value metadata labels for the node (e.g., location, environment).

nodes.description: List of Munin nodes (clients) to monitor.
List of node names to include in this group.

node_groups.description: Optional groups to organize nodes for web UI grouping (affects HTML 'group' links).
